newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tiger kills woman, mauls husband at Japan park.
newsitem.headline: Tiger kills woman, mauls husband at Japan park.

text.p: A Japanese woman was killed and her husband seriously hurt on Saturday when a Bengal tiger attacked the couple as they toured a safari park north of Tokyo, police said.
Hanako Terayama, 60, was attacked first by the tiger, who then turned on her 64-year-old husband, Tokuji, when he tried to help her, police said.

The woman, who was bitten over much of her body and died shortly after being taken to hospital, had left the vehicle she was riding as she toured the Gumma Safari World park in Tomioka, about 100 km (60 miles) north of Tokyo.
